{{Quote|Holy irreducible garbágina!|[[SplrMuck]]|<ref name="Echoes of the Jedi">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref>}}
The '''holy irreducible garbágina''' was an object in the religious cosmology of the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]]. Some worshippers swore by it.<ref name="Echoes of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the adventure ''[[Echoes of the Jedi]]'', the Ugor [[SplrMuck]] swears by the "holy irrebducible garbágina." As the Ugor pronunciation of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] often replaces hard syllables for softer ones and introduces extra phonemes, such as /b/, it is likely that ''irrebducible'' is simply his mispronunciation of the word ''irreducible.''
